metaTitle: Custom Recycled Garment Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled garment bags for your brand. Eco-friendly bulk options with imprint. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Made from post-consumer recycled materials, custom recycled garment bags let you protect clothing shipments while reinforcing your sustainability commitments. Perfect for uniform programs, trade show giveaways, or retail packaging, these bags reduce plastic waste without sacrificing durability. Choose screen printing or embroidery for your logo, and offer clients a reusable bag that aligns with green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled garment bags with zipper closure and printed logo, stacked for bulk orders.
